evals.prompt: Audite um servidor MCP STDIO em Python que utiliza print('Debug req') diretamente no stdout e verifique o veredito de higiene de protocolo.
evals.expected_behavior: Detect stdout pollution in the STDIO server (stdout_hygiene == 'POLLUTED') and reject global status (status == 'REJECTED') under Protocol Security Gate AUD-MCP-01.

evals.prompt: Inspect a ReAct agent module in Python/TypeScript/Go that does not define max_steps, max_retries, or recursion_limit.
evals.expected_behavior: Catalog the agent in audit_details.agents with has_max_steps == false and emit a critical unbounded cognitive loop alert (AUD-AGT-01).
assertions: gap_analysis flags missing loop depth guard

evals.prompt: Validate A2A v1.0 compliance on /.well-known/agent-card.json signed with JWS.
evals.expected_behavior: Extract name, supportedInterfaces, skills catalog, and confirm presence of JWS signatures block (has_jws_signatures == true).

evals.prompt: Verifique a higiene de binários na raiz do projeto quando há um arquivo executável (.exe ou .asar) fora da pasta bin/ ou dist/.
evals.expected_behavior: Identify compiled artifact outside bin/dist/build, count compiled_artifacts_count > 0, and mark binary_hygiene.status as 'REJECTED'.

evals.prompt: Run full architectural audit with persistence enabled (--persist) and validate memories/audit_report.json.
evals.expected_behavior: Generate memories/audit_report.json containing UTC timestamp, audit_version '1.0.0', summary, binary_hygiene, audit_details, and gap_analysis validated by Pydantic v2 (extra='forbid').

evals.prompt: Audite o contraste WCAG 2.1 AA, sombras em 3 camadas e tokens OKLCH da minha página React.
evals.expected_behavior: Abstain from agent-server-auditor; route frontend visual inspection to frontend-ui-ux-auditor.
assertions: Do not invoke agent_server_auditor.py for pure UI/CSS requests

evals.prompt: Audit my pytest suite for Green Build Illusion, assert True tautologies, and AAA pattern coverage.
evals.expected_behavior: Abstain from agent-server-auditor; route test-suite quality auditing to test-quality-auditor.
assertions: Do not invoke agent_server_auditor.py for unit test quality audits
